entities.summary: Constance J. Chang-Hasnain is a Taiwanese-American electrical engineer who is the chairperson and founder of Berxel Photonics Co. Ltd. and Whinnery Professor Emerita of the University of California, Berkeley. She was President of Optica in 2021.
